A *fact* is data that Pointsman looks up itself, for example whether a place is in a flood zone or how many files a pull request changes. The AI does not guess facts. A profile names each fact with a type from this page, and its rules read the fields of that type.

In the tables, *name* stands for the name the profile gives the fact.

## Shared fact types

Shared fact types (capabilities) are defined by the engine. Modules answer them, some only for their own layers.

### `inside`

Inside an area of a layer.

Answered by `@pointsman/facts-gsi` (layers `gsi-flood-max`).

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inside` | yes or no | true: the place is inside *name* |
| `rank` | number | the rank of *name* |
| `class` | text | the class of *name* |

Settings in a profile, besides `name`, `type` and `at`:

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layer` | string | yes | Layer id for inside and nearest, configured per deployment (source, licence, attribution). |

Missing as `no_location` when the request has no value at `at` (no location in the request). A lookup gives up after 3 s.

### `nearest`

The nearest feature of a layer.

Answered by `@pointsman/facts-gsi` (layers `gsi-shelters-flood`).

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | yes or no | true: a nearest *name* was found |
| `distance_m` | number | the distance to the nearest *name* (m) |
| `name` | text | the name of the nearest *name* |

Settings in a profile, besides `name`, `type` and `at`:

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layer` | string | yes | Layer id for inside and nearest, configured per deployment (source, licence, attribution). |

Missing as `no_location` when the request has no value at `at` (no location in the request). A lookup gives up after 3 s.

### `detour`

Extra metres around a closed section (needs a LineString).

Answered by `@pointsman/facts-valhalla`.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `possible` | yes or no | true: there is a way around (*name*) |
| `extra_m` | number | the extra distance of the way around (*name*) (m) |
| `route` | text | For people and maps only; rules cannot use it. |

Settings in a profile, besides `name`, `type` and `at`:

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | "drive" \| "walk" | no | For detour: by car (drive, the default) or on foot (walk). |
| `route` | boolean | no | For detour: also return the way around (route, an encoded polyline). Default false: the route starts and ends at the section, so it is stored with each decision. |

Missing as `no_location` when the request has no value at `at` (no location in the request). A lookup gives up after 8 s.

## `@pointsman/github`

Fact types of the module `@pointsman/github`. Deployment settings it reads: `FACTS_GITHUB`, `FACTS_GITHUB_TOKEN`, `FACTS_GITHUB_APP_ID`, `FACTS_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`, `FACTS_GITHUB_IGNORE_CHECK`.

### `github_pr`

A pull request.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | yes or no | true: the pull request *name* is open |
| `merged` | yes or no | true: the pull request *name* is merged |
| `draft` | yes or no | true: the pull request *name* is a draft |
| `wip_title` | yes or no | true: the title of *name* says WIP |
| `files` | number | the number of changed files of *name* |
| `changed_lines` | number | the number of changed lines of *name* |
| `base_is_default` | yes or no | true: *name* targets the default branch |
| `author_member` | yes or no | true: the author of *name* is a member of the owner |
| `author_dependabot` | yes or no | true: *name* is by Dependabot |
| `fork` | yes or no | true: *name* comes from a fork |
| `all_commits_verified` | yes or no | true: every commit of *name* has a verified signature |
| `pushed_by_author` | text | the answer to "did the author of *name* push every commit" |
| `author_sole_code_owner` | yes or no | true: the author of *name* is the only code owner of every changed file |

Missing as `no_pr` when the request has no value at `at` (no pull request in the request). A lookup gives up after 5 s.

### `github_paths`

Changed files that match paths.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `any` | yes or no | true: a changed file matches *name* |
| `all` | yes or no | true: every changed file matches *name* |
| `count` | number | the number of changed files that match *name* |

Settings in a profile, besides `name`, `type` and `at`:

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` | string[] | yes | For github_paths: the files that count, as globs from the top of the repository (*, ** and ? only), for example docs/**. |
| `except` | string[] | no | For github_paths: files that never count, even when they match paths. |

Missing as `no_pr` when the request has no value at `at` (no pull request in the request). A lookup gives up after 5 s.

### `github_checks`

Required checks on the head commit.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `required` | number | the number of required checks (*name*) |
| `green` | yes or no | true: every required check (*name*) passed |
| `pending` | yes or no | true: a required check (*name*) has not finished |
| `failed` | yes or no | true: a required check (*name*) failed |

Missing as `no_pr` when the request has no value at `at` (no pull request in the request). A lookup gives up after 5 s.

### `github_property`

A repository custom property.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | text | the value of *name* |

Settings in a profile, besides `name`, `type` and `at`:

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `property` | string | yes | For github_property: the name of a repository custom property. |

Missing as `no_pr` when the request has no value at `at` (no pull request in the request). A lookup gives up after 5 s.

### `github_workflows`

The GitHub Actions files it changes.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `changed` | number | the number of changed files in *name* (workflows, local actions, scanner settings) |
| `removed` | number | the number of removed files in *name* (workflows, local actions, scanner settings) |
| `unparsed` | number | the number of workflow and action.yml files in *name* that cannot be read safely |
| `bytes` | number | the size in bytes of the changed files in *name* |
| `privileged` | number | the number of changed workflows in *name* that run with the base repository's token |
| `privileged_new` | number | the number of such triggers that *name* adds |
| `head_checkout` | number | the number of privileged jobs in *name* that may check out other code |
| `pwn_request` | number | the number of privileged jobs in *name* that may run the checked-out code |
| `artifact_in_privileged` | number | the number of privileged jobs in *name* that download an artifact of another run |
| `remote_reusable` | number | the number of jobs in *name* that call a reusable workflow of another repository from a privileged workflow, or pass every secret |
| `secrets_new` | number | the number of secrets that jobs in *name* newly read |
| `injection` | number | the number of untrusted expressions in scripts in *name* |
| `permissions_missing` | number | the number of jobs in *name* without permissions |
| `write_all` | number | the number of broad write permissions in *name* |
| `write_new` | number | the number of write permissions that *name* adds |
| `persisted` | number | the number of checkouts in *name* that keep the token on disk |
| `unpinned` | number | the number of actions and images in *name* not pinned to a commit or digest |
| `suppressions_new` | number | the number of scanner exceptions that *name* adds |
| `local_unresolved` | number | the number of local actions and reusable workflows in *name* that a person must read |
| `detail` | text | For people and maps only; rules cannot use it. |

Settings in a profile, besides `name`, `type` and `at`:

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `privileged_triggers` | string[] | no | For github_workflows: more triggers that run in the base repository's context, added to the defaults. |
| `inert_actions` | string[] | no | For github_workflows: more actions (owner/repo or owner/*) known not to run workspace content, added to the defaults (actions/checkout, actions/upload-artifact). |
| `safe_contexts` | string[] | no | For github_workflows: more github.* paths that are safe in a script (numbers, ids, commit ids), added to the defaults. Exact paths in lower case. |
| `base_refs` | string[] | no | For github_workflows: more expressions that name the base in a checkout's ref, added to the defaults (github.sha, github.ref). |
| `git_actions` | string[] | no | For github_workflows: actions (owner/repo or owner/*) that need the git credentials of a checkout. |
| `pin_exempt` | string[] | no | For github_workflows: actions (owner/repo or owner/*) that need not be pinned to a commit. |

Missing as `no_pr` when the request has no value at `at` (no pull request in the request). A lookup gives up after 5 s.

### `github_copilot`

Copilot code review on the pull request.

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `requested` | yes or no | true: a Copilot review of *name* is requested |
| `reviewed_head` | yes or no | true: Copilot reviewed the head commit of *name* |
| `approved_head` | yes or no | true: Copilot approved the head commit of *name* |
| `reviews` | number | the number of Copilot reviews of *name* |

Missing as `no_pr` when the request has no value at `at` (no pull request in the request). A lookup gives up after 5 s.

## Missing reasons

A fact that has no value is *missing*: its field `missing` is true and `reason` says why. Rules can test both.

| Reason | Meaning | From |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `unavailable` | the data is not available | any fact |
| `timeout` | the lookup took too long | any fact |
| `error` | an error | any fact |
| `no_location` | no location in the request | `inside`, `nearest`, `detour` |
| `no_pr` | no pull request in the request | `github_pr`, `github_paths`, `github_checks`, `github_property`, `github_workflows`, `github_copilot` |
| `stale` | the pull request has a newer commit | `@pointsman/github` |
